subject: OrbitAI renewal — request for one-time accommodation
messages:
From: Kate Johnson <kate@orbitai.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-26T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal questions & need for price relief

Hi Tessa,

We appreciate the work with Redwood over the past year — the inference performance has been great. That said, our budget for next year is very constrained; the renewal numbers in the quote are well outside what Procurement will approve. I wanted to be candid: unless we can get a meaningful one-time concession (term reset + credit or deeper discount for committed capacity), we will need to move to a lower-cost provider for some non-critical workloads.

Can you summarize any flexibility you have on a one-time retention package and the approval path? Our renewal deadline is 10/10 and Procurement needs formal approval before then.

Thanks,
Kate
VP of Infrastructure
OrbitAI

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-27T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal questions & need for price relief

Hi Kate —

Really appreciate the straightforward note. I pulled together a short set of options that would preserve rollout performance while addressing OrbitAI's cost concern. Summary below and I attached a formal proposal:

- Option A (recommended): 12-month renewal, 10% one-time credit applied to Q1 invoice + one-time SLA credit (4 hrs/month additional incident allowance) for the first 3 months. Requires Sales VP approval.
- Option B: 24-month term reset at current list with 7% up-front discount; requires Deal Desk approval and Finance sign-off.
- Option C: A usage-tier reclassification for 6 months (move 40% of tokens to economy runner) to reduce run-costs; requires engineering to accept reduced throughput for those jobs.

I can escalate for quick review if you confirm which option you'd like prioritized.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2026-09-27-orbitai-options.pdf (proposal stub)

Team —

Looping you in to request approval path and recommended concession. OrbitAI is a mid-market AI platform; they run high-volume async scoring and a small set of low-latency endpoints for trials. Kate flagged a hard procurement deadline of 10/10.

What I'm asking for: 1) approval to offer Option A (10% one-time credit + 3 months enhanced SLA allowance) up to $60k one-time cost; 2) authority to sign a one-time term reset if needed; 3) heads-up on any required finance/contract routing.

Why: retention probability is high with a small concession and SLA boost; losing OrbitAI would be a revenue and reference hit in our ML vertical.

Attachments: 2026-09-28-orbitai-savings-proposal.pdf

Quick notes from my side:
- Current ARR: ~$420k; renewal request is for same footprint with annual uplift.
- Customer willing to sign a 12-month renewal immediately if we can commit to Option A.

Thanks,
Tessa
